name: THE Elantra 1.6
description: The ELANTRA 1.6 Special Edition adds a powered sunroof, wireless charging, an 8-way powered driver's seat and a choice of upgraded interiors to a proven 1.6-litre petrol sedan.
highlights: 6-speed automatic with Sport, Eco and Normal modes
8" touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
8-way powered driver's seat with lumbar support
Tetra LED headlamps with daytime running lights

stories.title: Sharper by design
stories.text: Tetra LED headlamps, a rear spoiler and black side mirrors give the Special Edition a crisp, confident look from every angle.

stories.title: Comfort for every trip
stories.text: Choose standard fabric or upgraded leather in Cappuccino, Burgundy or Beige, with an 8-way powered driver's seat and rear AC vents.

stories.title: Smooth, efficient power
stories.text: A 1.6-litre petrol engine and 6-speed automatic make everyday driving relaxed, with Sport, Eco and Normal modes to suit the road.

stories.title: Connected and in control
stories.text: An 8-inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless charging, cruise control and push-button start keep everything within reach.

features.title: Leather steering wheel with cruise control
Leather gear knob with drive modes

name: THE Elantra Hybrid
description: The ELANTRA Hybrid pairs a 1.6-litre GDi engine with an electric motor for 139 hp combined, a 6-speed EcoShift dual-clutch gearbox and a cabin led by twin 10.25-inch screens.
highlights: Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
Rear AC vents and USB Type-C charging

stories.title: Parametric, through and through
stories.text: Sharp parametric surfaces, a full-width LED light bar and a fastback roofline make the ELANTRA Hybrid instantly recognisable.

stories.title: A calmer cabin
stories.text: Heated and ventilated seats, a powered sunroof and dual-zone climate control with rear vents keep every passenger comfortable.

stories.title: Electric help on every drive
stories.text: The engine and electric motor work together for 139 hp and smooth, fuel-saving acceleration, switching between them on their own.

stories.title: Two screens, one view
stories.text: Twin 10.25-inch displays bring navigation, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and live hybrid energy flow into one clean panel.

name: THE Sonata
description: The Sonata pairs a long, low fastback design with a roomy, leather-trimmed cabin. Its 2.5-litre Smartstream engine and 6-speed automatic make long motorway runs effortless.
highlights: Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear vents
Five drive modes including Sport and Eco

stories.title: Coupé-like presence
stories.text: A long, low silhouette with hidden lighting and a sweeping roofline gives the Sonata real presence wherever it parks.

stories.title: Room to stretch out
stories.text: Leather seating, generous rear legroom and a panoramic sunroof make the Sonata as comfortable for passengers as it is for the driver.

stories.title: Effortless on the motorway
stories.text: The 2.5-litre engine and 6-speed automatic deliver smooth, quiet power, with five drive modes to match the journey.

stories.title: Simple, modern controls
stories.text: A touchscreen, a digital instrument cluster, push-button gear selection and wireless charging keep the cabin clean and intuitive.

name: THE Sonata N Line
description: Sonata N Line takes Hyundai's executive sedan and adds a 290 hp 2.5-litre turbo, an 8-speed wet dual-clutch gearbox and N Line styling inside and out.
highlights: N Line bumpers, badges and twin exhaust
Dual 12.3" curved displays with head-up display

stories.title: N Line, inside and out
stories.text: Sharper bumpers, N Line badging, a rear spoiler and twin exhaust tips give this Sonata a sportier stance.

stories.title: Sports seats, all-day comfort
stories.text: N Line seats with red detailing are heated and ventilated, with an 8-way powered driver's seat and lumbar support.

stories.title: 290 horsepower
stories.text: A 2.5-litre turbocharged engine and 8-speed wet dual-clutch gearbox deliver quick, responsive acceleration.

stories.title: A cockpit built around you
stories.text: Dual 12.3-inch curved displays, a head-up display, Bose 12-speaker sound and a surround view monitor.

name: THE Tucson Hybrid
tagline: The hybrid SUV for every journey.
description: Tucson Hybrid combines a 1.6-litre turbo engine with an electric motor for 232 hp, wrapped in Hyundai's parametric SUV design. Choose Smart FWD or Signature AWD.
highlights: Heated and ventilated front seats, heated steering wheel
Smart powered tailgate and remote engine start

stories.title: Parametric presence
stories.text: Hidden parametric LED lamps that disappear into the grille when switched off, and bold sculpted surfaces down each side.

stories.title: Space that adapts
stories.text: A quiet, spacious cabin with heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel and rear seats that fold for up to 1,903 litres.

stories.title: Hybrid power, AWD grip
stories.text: 232 hp from the 1.6-litre turbo hybrid, with an AWD option and terrain modes for confident driving off the beaten path.

stories.title: A connected cockpit
stories.text: Panoramic curved displays, a surround view monitor, remote engine start and fingerprint authentication.

name: THE Santa Fe Hybrid
description: The SANTA FE Hybrid is a seven-seat SUV with a 1.6-litre turbo hybrid producing 227 hp, a 6-speed automatic and an AWD option with multi-terrain modes.
highlights: Smart FWD or Signature AWD with terrain modes
Surround View and Blind-Spot View Monitors

stories.title: Made to be noticed
stories.text: T-shaped LED daytime running lights, a wide grille and 19-inch alloys give the SANTA FE real road presence.

stories.title: Room for seven
stories.text: Three rows of seating, heated and ventilated seats and a panoramic sunroof make long family journeys easy.

stories.title: Ready for any terrain
stories.text: 227 hp from the turbo hybrid, with Snow, Mud and Sand modes on the Signature AWD.

stories.title: Everything at your fingertips
stories.text: A digital cluster, shift-by-wire controls, wireless charging and a surround view monitor for easy parking.

name: THE Palisade
tagline: Command the road, three rows deep.
description: The PALISADE Hybrid is Hyundai's flagship SUV: a 2.5-litre turbo hybrid with 329 hp, all-wheel drive and a premium three-row cabin in 7 or 8-seat layouts.
highlights: 2.5L turbo hybrid, 329 hp and 460 Nm combined
Ergo Motion relaxation seats with leg rest

stories.title: Flagship presence
stories.text: A bold, upright front, vertical LED lighting and up to 21-inch wheels make the PALISADE the biggest statement in the range.

stories.title: First class in every row
stories.text: Nappa leather on Calligraphy, Ergo Motion relaxation seats with leg rests and a dual-pane sunroof over all three rows.

stories.title: Hybrid muscle
stories.text: 329 hp and 460 Nm from the 2.5-litre turbo hybrid, with all-wheel drive and terrain modes for any road.

stories.title: A wraparound cockpit
stories.text: Panoramic curved displays, a head-up display and Bose sound with 14 speakers.

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: AWD with Snow / Mud / Sand modes

name: THE IONIQ 5
description: IONIQ 5 is Hyundai's all-electric crossover: up to 500 km of range, 325 PS all-wheel drive, a flat-floor lounge-like cabin and Vehicle-to-Load power on the go.
highlights: Dual-motor AWD, up to 325 PS and 605 Nm
Up to 500 km range (84 kWh battery)
Surround View and Blind-Spot View Monitors

stories.title: Pixels and precision
stories.text: Parametric Pixel lamps, crisp creases and a long 3,000 mm wheelbase give IONIQ 5 its unmistakable look.

stories.title: A lounge on wheels
stories.text: A flat floor, the sliding Universal Island console and relaxation seats turn the cabin into a calm, open space.

stories.title: Instant electric power
stories.text: Dual motors with all-wheel drive deliver up to 325 PS and 605 Nm, with up to 500 km on a single charge.

stories.title: Connected and capable
stories.text: Dual displays, a surround view monitor and Vehicle-to-Load, which powers devices and appliances straight from the battery.

specs.label: Range
specs.value: Up to 500 km (84 kWh) / up to 430 km (72.6 kWh)

name: THE IONIQ 6
description: IONIQ 6 is Hyundai's electric streamliner: a sleek fastback sedan with up to 519 km of range, 325 PS all-wheel drive and Vehicle-to-Load.
highlights: Up to 519 km range (77.4 kWh battery)
Heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats

stories.title: Shaped by the wind
stories.text: One sweeping curve from nose to tail, pixel lights and a ducktail spoiler give IONIQ 6 its streamliner shape.

stories.title: Calm and comfortable
stories.text: Heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats and customisable ambient lighting.

stories.title: Electric performance
stories.text: Dual motors deliver 325 PS and 605 Nm, with up to 519 km of range.

stories.title: Digital, simplified
stories.text: A wide integrated display, column shift-by-wire, wireless charging and Vehicle-to-Load.

name: THE Porter
description: The Hyundai Porter H-100 is built for business: a durable 1-ton light commercial vehicle with a 2.6-litre diesel engine, trusted by fleets and family enterprises.
